caption: find your sign. tag the one in tier one. the sun at 8.3° capricorn squares saturn at 8.3° aries tonight, 6:24 pm et.

slides.headline: the sun squares *saturn* tonight. the year-end reality check
the *sun* and saturn sit 90° apart
slides.body: a square is a quarter turn: sun in capricorn, saturn in aries. it reads as friction that forces a decision. mercury makes the same square tomorrow.

rows.label: capricorn
rows.text: your season meets a wall. go around it.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: saturn is in your sign. own one promise.

rows.label: cancer
rows.text: partner vs. career. you can say both.

rows.label: libra
rows.text: home vs. relationship. pick a time to talk.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: say no to the extra shift.

rows.label: gemini
rows.text: friends need a real yes or no.

slides.headline: release, don't *ghost*. end the year clean
slides.body: one honest goodbye beats a silent january.
